Track Record

Program Success

Experience across large, complex, multi-discipline and multi-location IT infrastructure programs for government and commercial customers worldwide — including work at over 120 U.S. Government and DoD facilities.

Global Information Network

Major Government net-centric initiative creating a global bandwidth-available environment. Tier-one design support for 100+ international sites including site surveys, engineering, construction, AC/DC power, generators, UPS, HVAC, fire suppression, and node cabling. Performed installations at 75% of GIG-BE sites and established a PMO in Europe.

Data Center Consolidations & Builds

Tier-one support for classified large data center consolidation and construction: facility design/build, electrical upgrades, NOC construction, power systems, HVAC, racks and cabinets. Full technical and trade fit-out of classified data centers and operations centers for national security customers.

Specialized Secure Construction — Overseas C2 Facilities

Interior construction of an 82,698 sq ft two-story secure facility with admin, secure data centers, command and control, utility plant, and 170,000 sq ft secure work area. 95% of fit-out including architectural, fire, plumbing, mechanical, electrical, RF/EMP shielding, and chemical/biological filtration. Full-time onsite PMO.

Communication Shelter Build & Modernization

Design and construction of pre-cast concrete communications shelters with underground cable vaults, power systems, generators, UPS, HVAC, fire suppression, security, and grounding. Facility infrastructure upgrades for Network Enterprise Centers including power, HVAC, and environmental monitoring.

Worldwide Power System Upgrades

Since 2016, support under a DoD multiple-award contract providing online double-conversion UPS (3 kVA to 1100+ kVA) and associated equipment for power conditioning and continuation at 100+ CONUS and OCONUS sites. Also managed hydrogen fuel cell installations at 125+ locations nationwide.

Network Operations Centers & Security

NOC construction and reconfiguration including work areas, power, grounding, HVAC, security cameras, and situational awareness displays. County-wide electronic security design, modernization, and maintenance across 25+ buildings (video, access control, identity management, intrusion detection).
